name: @otp/api
//: The live routes are apps/api/api/score.ts and top.ts, imported by RELATIVE path and bundled by
apps/game/scripts/vercel-output.mjs into self-contained CommonJS for Vercel's Build Output API.
Nothing reaches this package by deep path any more, so an exports map would no longer break a
route -- but the routes' '.ts' specifiers still assume a bundler or Node type stripping, never
a per-file TypeScript compile, which is exactly what crashed them on Vercel.
